```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(rio)
library(here)
library(flexdashboard)

nhanes_data <- import(here("data", "cleaned_NHANES.csv"))
```

## Sample overview {data-height=650}

### Age distribution of NHANES participants

```{r sample-plot, echo=FALSE, out.width="75%", fig.align="center"}
knitr::include_graphics(here::here("figures", "ex2_age.png"))
```

## Key indicators {data-height=350}

### Participants aged 21 or older

```{r age-gauge}
pct_21_plus <- round(100 * mean(nhanes_data$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

gauge(
  pct_21_plus,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  symbol = "%",
  sectors = gaugeSectors(
    danger = c(0, 25),
    warning = c(25, 50),
    success = c(50, 100)
  )
)
```

### Average systolic blood pressure above 120 mm Hg

```{r sbp-value-box}
sbp_columns <- c("systolic_bp_1",
                 "systolic_bp_2",
                 "systolic_bp_3",
                 "systolic_bp_4")

nhanes_data$average_sbp <- rowMeans(nhanes_data[sbp_columns], na.rm = TRUE)
nhanes_data$average_sbp[is.nan(nhanes_data$average_sbp)] <- NA_real_

pct_above_120 <- round(100 * mean(nhanes_data$average_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

valueBox(paste0(pct_above_120, "%"),
         caption = "Average systolic BP > 120 mm Hg",
         color = "#D8EAF5")
```
